notes.title: August 02 Update Notes
notes.content:
Dear players,

We’d like to inform you that our game will no longer support the Steamworks API.

With our recent game engine update, we also reviewed the current feature integrations. Please note that the engine we use has never natively supported Steamworks—this functionality was something we manually integrated. Due to maintenance costs and future compatibility concerns, we’ve decided to remove this custom feature as part of the update.

We sincerely appreciate your understanding and continued support. If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach out to us anytime.

Thank you for playing! 

Love Goal

notes.title: Love Goal Update: Roxy’s Story Continues!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340322/127311c175ec241d1f6d1f99c6873dfcbc98513f.png"]📢 Love Goal Update Released!



❣️ Introducing the “Roxy Side Story” ❣️

Is a steady, calm relationship truly fulfilling?

Does it ever feel like something that’s “neither tasty nor worth throwing away”?

When unexpected temptation and excitement arise, can we really stay true to our original feelings?



This update adds over 30,000 words of new story content, 4 beautiful CG illustrations, and multiple branching choices waiting for you to explore. Dive into a parallel world filled with very different possibilities.

Due to the addition of new scripts and artwork, the game’s price has been adjusted starting today.

Players who have already purchased the game will not be affected.

We sincerely hope for your continued support, so we can keep bringing you even more high-quality content!

(Reminder: The game is still ongoing and not yet fully completed.)



Thank you for supporting Love Goal!

We’ll keep working hard to deliver stories that stay with you. 💖

notes.title: Love Goal – Development Progress Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340322/47c83e123db0a1c75f55d2d851770f7092da05e1.png

Hello everyone!

It’s been several months since our last update—thank you all for your patience.
Production progress slowed down a bit recently due to our preparations for the CWT event. We sincerely apologize for the delay.

Currently, we’ve completed over 20,000 words of story content, and we’re planning to release an update in July!

As a token of our appreciation for your continued support, we’ve decided to share a sneak peek: an early preview of a CG illustration!
Although it's been censored with a mosaic, can you guess which male lead is taking a shower in the bathroom?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340322/fd54b6ae0f65b6caa113833d685ab69ad7edb18c.png

Please look forward to the upcoming update—I’ll keep working hard on development!

Love Goal

With the integration of Steamworks, the Windows version of the game now supports Steam Overlay! This allows you to easily access features like friends, chats, and achievements while playing, without needing to leave the game screen.

These enhancements were inspired by your feedback, and we're committed to further optimizing the game to provide the best interactive story experience possible.

Players can now save their progress in advance and gain insights into their current progress, making it easier to explore multiple story endings!

🔹 Improved Class Reunion Multi-Choice Interface
The interface has been redesigned with a more intuitive tab-based layout, allowing for easier navigation and smoother decision-making.
